in_sanskrit.name: सक्षी
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: The one who sees, the one who knows, the one who witnesses, the one who perceives, the one who beholds

in_hindi.name: सक्षी
in_hindi.long_meaning: Male: A witness, a trustworthy person, a reliable source, a spectator. Female: A spectator, an observer, a seer, a knower.

in_tamil.name: சக்ஷி
in_tamil.long_meaning: One who observes, one who sees, one who perceives, one who knows

in_marathi.name: Sakshi
in_marathi.long_meaning: Sakshi हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। One who sees, observes, or witnesses. Can refer to a deity, a divine witness, or an observer in a spiritual or metaphysical context.
